summary: Iteration 174 - AI Concierge Chat tested. All backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend concierge bubble, panel, suggestions, and chat all functional. GPT-5.2 returns grounded responses with real hotel context (Aldgate Flats, check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00, room types). Embed mode correctly hides concierge. Regression tests passed for admin login and loyalty API.

integration_issues.issue: Known issue from iter 173: Playwright's fill() doesn't properly trigger React's controlled input onChange/onBlur. Backend API works correctly (verified via curl).
integration_issues.workaround: Use page.evaluate with nativeInputValueSetter to set value and dispatch 'input' event
integration_issues.priority: LOW - UI works correctly for real users, only affects automated testing
